content: Hino, kiyaha malaghilo ndo kihwili ghweka kya ghala gha maha ghaapala kuhika, na ndo chepa utwihiliko ghwa milando yila ya telatele, nyambi ndo yiyila yila ya malaghilo yiitendekehwa ngungwa mbaka ngungwa, yaahotoleka ndwee kubhayoha bhandu bhala bhanakutundamila Chgapanga.
Handa bhandu abho bhaantundamila Chgapanga bhangayohwite ulemwa ghwabhe hoto, bhangaghendelelite ng'obhe kulibhoa kukita abhegha na ulemwa, na nyambi ahyo hyoha hingalekitwe,
peni nyambi ahyo hiitendekwa kila ngungwa ngati kubhakulungwa bhandu ulemwa ghwabhe.
Kiyaha mwahi ghwa makambako gha senga na makambako gha mbuhi ghwahotola ng'obhe kubhuha ulemwa.
Kubhukana na agha, Kilisito pakabheghite kanguhika pannima, kakinng'ombela Chgapanga,

content.text: peni ghukimikila kala mmili kwa kya nenga.
Ghungunoghelwa ng'obhe na nyambi ya kuyochwa anyama mu likuta
handa payityekitwe ya kya nenga mu kitabho kya malaghilo’”

content: Kandahi kakiyanda kulongela, “Ghulema na ghunoghelwa ng'obhe na nyambi ya kuyochwa na ya kuyoha ulemwa.” Kakilongela habhu hata payibhele bhwengu ndo nyambi yikibhegha tela na malaghilo.
Mbole kakilongela, “Megha apa, Ghwe Chgapanga hika kughatenda mapalo ghako.” Habhu Chgapanga kakigilimbula nyambi ya makachu na kihyengo kyake kakibhika nyambi yingi yimu.
Kiyaha Yesu Kilisito kakitwihilia mapalo gha Chgapanga, twenga tunguyohwa na kutendwa bhaabhaghulitwe kwa kya Chgapanga kwa njila ya nyambi ya mmili ghwa Yesu Kilisito ghuubhuhitwe mala yimo ghweka.
Ndundame ywohele Nnyahudi kangutenda lihengo lyake lya kutundamila kila linjubha na kutendekeha nyambi yila yila patangalo, nyambi yene yangahotola kubhua ulemwa.
Peni Kilisito kakitenda nyambi yimu kwa kya ulemwa, nyambi yinakutenda lihengo manjubha ghoha, mbole kakitama mbande ya nnilo ya Chgapanga.
Kutandila apo kangualindila amyanja bhake mbaka kabhabhike pahi mu utabhala ghwake.
Hino, kiyaha Kilisita kakilibhuha nyambi mala yimu, kabhayoha ulemwa ngati mmeghe bhandu bhake manjubha ghoha mu mamjubha ghoha bhala bhoha bhaayohwa ulemwa ghwabhe.
Naywo Nhuki ghwa Chgapanga kangutughombea yakya nnando aghu kwa kulongela,

content.text: Ndabhika malaghilo ghangu mu myoyo yabhe
na kughatyeka malaghilo ghangu mu mahala ghabhe.”

content: Mbole kakighendelela kulongela, “Ndaghukulungwa ng'obhe kangi ulemwa hangi uhokelo ghwabhe.”
Hino, ulemwa paghubhuhwa, kahone nhokolo ghwa kubhuha nyambi ya kughubhuha ulemwa.
Tunheghelele Chgapanga
Hino, maalongo bhango, kwa mwahi ghwa Yesu tungupeghwa mwoyo ghuukangamalite ghwa kuyingila pang'anyimo munu.
Ywombe katuhughulila njila ya hyono, njila ya ubhumi, kukindila lila lipasia ghwene ndo mmili ghwake mwene.
Hino, tubhegha na Ndundame nkulu nnolelekeha ghwa nyumba ya Chgapanga.
Hino, tunheghelele Chgapanga kwa mwoyo ya nyanyi yene yinakunhyubhalila hoto, patubhegha na myoyo yiiyohitwe kubhukana na hwacho hakataho, na mibhili yiighululitwe kwa machi gha nyanyi.
Tughungile lidumbilo lyetu litulihyubhalila na litulikambuka kyanga bhwaghalili, kiyaha Chgapanga ywakatendite naghilo lyake ndo ywa kuhyubhalika.
Kangi tungunoghwa kuyonjokehana myoyo ngati tupalane na kutendelana gha maha twenga kwa twenga mu mapalo na mu kughatenda gha maha.

Kangi tukotoke kuleka hila hitohe hya kukungana papamu, handa paatenda bhangi paalekite kukongana, kangi yingutunogha kuyonjokehana myoyo handa paatenda bhangi, Linjubha lila lya Chgapanga linguheghelela.
Handa patughendelela kutenda ulemwa kwa likaho mbole ya kupeghwa ghula umaha ghwa yila hoto, kahone nyaambi yaahotolekwa kubhuhwa kwa kya kutubhuhila ulemwa.
Peni kiihighalite ndo kulindila toso ya Chgapanga kwa lyogha na mwoto nkalipa ghwakubhakanjaghana bhaannema Chgapanga.
Mundu ywehele ywakaghalemite malaghilo gha Musa kaakomwagha kyanga luhungu, mbaka pabheghe uyimiho ghwa bhandu abhili ebu andatu.

Bhuli, munguhwachila bhuli yikinnogha ng'obhe kihyato kiibheghte kikulu kyanalumu mundu yula ywakanpughana Mwana ghwa Chgapanga, na kubhoa mwahi ghwa ninganilo ghuunnyohite kukita ndo kilibhi kihakata, na kuntendela hyeta Nhuki luhungu?
Kiyaha tungummanya kukita Chgapanga kakilongela, “Lihengo lya kubhuyiha kibhuyiho ndo lihengo lyang” Na hila hila Chgapanga kakilongela, “Kataatosa bhandu bhake.”
Ndo nnando ghwa kuyoghoha muno, kukukongana na toso ya Chgapanga yuna ubhumi.
Mughakulungwe manjubha ghala gha kalongohi, pannyandite kuhyubhalila Kilisito, payibhele mukimokola kimbamanda peni mukilimbilila.
Pamoo pangi mukilighwa na kuyuyuhwa mu muu, pamoo pangi mukinoghwa kubhatangatila bhala bhaapamanditwe handa mwenga.
Mukiabhonela luhungu bhala bhaabheghite mu hiphopo, mukiyitikila kwa uyelelo kutolelwa utopelo ghwenu kiyaha mukimanya kukita mu myoyo yenu hikibhegha hilibhi hyanga kupela manjubha ghoha.
Hino, nkotoke kughuhobheha ukangamalo ghwenu, kiyaha mwaakamuhwa lilumbo likulu kuhuma kwa Chgapanga
Yinguanogha mmeghe na ulimbililo ngati mmokole kughatwihiliha mapalo gha Chgapanga na kupeghwa kila kyakanaghihite.
Handa paghatyekitwe Malembo,

content.text: Peni yunakutama handa pambala, katalama kwa kunhyubhalila nenga,

content: Peni twenga tubhegha ng'obhe handa bhandu bhanakuleka kuntughila Chgapanga na kuhobha, ngati tubhegha papamu na bhandu bhaanhyubhalila na kulopoleghwa.
